patterns.label: Catalogue hero
patterns.looksLike: A full-bleed cream band above the course grid: breadcrumb trail, a large H1, a one-line lead, 2-3 big live numbers with small labels on the right, a wide search box with a solid button, then a row of rounded 'Popular:' shortcut chips.
figmaCues: full-width band directly above stream tabs or the grid, 200-320px tall, tinted (cream/sand) fill
breadcrumb text 'Home / Courses' over a 40-48px heading
2-3 large numerals each with a small caption ('24 courses & resources')
a 56-64px tall input with a filled button on its right
a 'Popular:' label followed by 4-8 pill chips
patterns.useWhen: A course listing page opens with a search-led band. Numbers shown are courses, streams or categories.
patterns.avoidWhen: The design shows a marketing hero (image, CTA buttons) — use heroSection. Never add a separate heroSection above a catalogue that has this band: it duplicates the H1 and the search.

requires.detail: stats of kind 'streams'/'categories' and chips with streamSlug need streams.source 'folderLibrary'

pitfalls: Stats are LIVE (kind: courses | streams | categories). Never author the numbers from the design; the label is the only text.
The breadcrumb is hidden on the site's home route; on other routes the last item is the current page and is never a link.
Popular chips act by precedence: searchValue > streamSlug (+categorySlug) > quickFilterId > route. streamSlug/categorySlug are folder slugs, not names.
At most 3 stats and 8 chips are shown.

patterns.useWhen: The design's content column differs from the default.
patterns.avoidWhen: The design uses the default width.
pitfalls: px of content, gutters excluded; 320-2400, anything else is ignored.

patterns.label: Fonts
patterns.looksLike: One body font across the design (e.g. Lato), with Devanagari runs in Noto Sans Devanagari.
figmaCues: TEXT styles share one family
Devanagari text layers
patterns.useWhen: The design names a font from the registered list.
patterns.avoidWhen: The font is not on the registered list — pick the closest one and say so.
pitfalls: Do NOT set fonts.headingFamily on a Hindi site: it replaces the heading stack without the Devanagari fallback.
Lato has no 500/600: Semibold in the design renders as 700.

patterns.label: Course formats
patterns.looksLike: A format taxonomy (E-books, Live sessions, Short film…) on card pills, the FORMAT filter and path steps.
figmaCues: the same set of 4-8 media-type words on cards and in a filter group
patterns.useWhen: Courses come in several formats the design names.
patterns.avoidWhen: Every course has the same format.

requires.detail: courses tagged format-<key>, or a level name listed in levels[]

pitfalls: Keys are lower-case slugs; a course's format is tag format-<key> first, then a listed tag, then a listed level name.
Labels are base-language text shown through the site dictionary.

patterns.label: Course languages
patterns.looksLike: Language chips on cards and a LANGUAGE filter: one course, several language versions.
figmaCues: 'EN' / 'हिं' chips on cards
patterns.useWhen: Courses exist in more than one language.
patterns.avoidWhen: All courses share one language.

requires.detail: language words in the level names, or versionGroups pairing separate packages

pitfalls: versionGroups lists course (package) ids of one course in several languages; the admin pairs them in the editor — leave it empty.

versionGroups: <course id (English version): leave empty — the admin groups versions>

patterns.label: Naming
patterns.looksLike: The site's own word for a level/course ('Format' instead of 'Level').
figmaCues: filter or card labels that rename the platform's level/course/session terms
patterns.useWhen: The design uses its own term for levels, courses or sessions.
patterns.avoidWhen: The institute's Naming Settings already match.
pitfalls: Affects this site only, not the institute's other surfaces.

patterns.label: Site cart
patterns.looksLike: One site-wide cart icon whose checkout is a store product page.
figmaCues: a cart icon in the header
'Add whole path to cart' actions
patterns.useWhen: Visitors buy several courses in one checkout.
patterns.avoidWhen: There is no store product page selling every course.

requires.detail: a store product page that sells the courses

pitfalls: Absent = the original catalogue cart.

siteCart.storeProductPageCode: <productPageCode: leave empty — the admin picks a product page in the editor>
<productPageCode: leave empty — the admin picks a product page in the editor>

patterns.label: Site languages
patterns.looksLike: A language switcher; the site in two languages.
figmaCues: a हिन्दी | EN toggle
the same frame repeated in two scripts
patterns.useWhen: The design is bilingual.
patterns.avoidWhen: The site has one language.

requires.detail: translations keyed by the EXACT base-language text

pitfalls: Never write the second language into props: translations live in strings[locale][<exact base text>].
Keys ending in Id/Slug/Url/Route/Color/Value and everything under render/styles/style/theme are not translated by key.

recipes.name: Editorial catalogue
recipes.description: A Courses page built from ONE courseCatalog with every editorial opt-in, then a help band.

sections.note: Deep-merge the patterns' minimal objects into one section's props: merge nested objects key by key (hero, filterSidebar, render…) and concatenate arrays (columnSections, quickFilters, customFilters). The hero carries the H1, so the section title is empty; the legacy level/session/tag filter groups are off (FORMAT and the sidebar replace them).

recipes.name: Learning paths
recipes.description: Editorial hero, goals + featured path, an institutions band, the remaining paths, an app band, how-it-works cards and a closing band.

recipes.name: Brand chrome
recipes.description: Compact editorial header with a streams mega menu and the brand footer with a newsletter, on a bilingual site.
